name: io.github.navdeep-h-singh/video-to-llm
description: Read local video by turning it into one timestamped, citable document — once. Fully offline, resumable, built for hours of video.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server on stdio.

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_TO_LLM_OUTPUT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Where processed video is kept and looked up. Defaults to ~/Documents/VideoToLLM. Set this to point an agent at an existing library rather than starting a new one.
